Title: Public preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server intelligent performance

Body.Content:
Intelligent performance features for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server is now in public preview. This latest release of intelligent performance features is comprised of Query Store on Postgres 11 and 12. Query Store collects and stores query execution statistics. With this functionality, you can inspect your database to understand your workloads, identify bottlenecks, and detect changes in query performance over time. 

Learn more.
